claims.text: Massive hemoptysis: stabilize (usually in the ICU) before testing.
claims.quote: Patients with massive hemoptysis require treatment and stabilization, usually in an intensive care unit, before testing.

claims.text: Imaging always, usually chest x-ray first.
claims.quote: Imaging should always be performed, typically chest radiography

claims.text: CT and bronchoscopy if the x-ray is abnormal or the history does not fit bronchitis.
claims.quote: Patients with abnormal results and patients without a supporting history should undergo CT and bronchoscopy.

claims.text: Labs: CBC, platelet count, PT and PTT.
claims.quote: Patients usually should have a complete blood count, a platelet count, and measurement of prothrombin time (PT) and partial thromboplastin time (PTT).
Urinalysis should be performed to look for signs of glomerulonephritis (hematuria, proteinuria, casts).
